codeReview.summary: The mathematical test suite functionality is fully implemented across tests/test_embedding.py (7 tests) and tests/test_vector_store.py (10 tests), rather than as a single test_suite.py file. All 17 tests pass and comprehensively verify: (1) Mean pooling formula E = sum(T_i * M_i) / max(sum(M_i), epsilon), (2) Attention mask application, (3) Epsilon preventing division by zero, (4) Cosine similarity formula dot(A,B)/(||A||*||B||), (5) Edge cases (identical, orthogonal, opposite vectors), (6) Floating-point precision within 1e-6 tolerance, and (7) Deterministic outputs. The implementation meets all requirements from the 'create-mathematical-test-suite' feature description despite the different file structure.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The test suite was distributed across component-specific test files (test_embedding.py, test_vector_store.py) rather than consolidated into a single test_suite.py as described in the feature.
